These browser libraries are bundled into the SecureVault binary. No CDN or
network access is required at runtime.

- Marked: https://marked.js.org/ (MIT)
- DOMPurify: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0)

The `.version` files record the pinned npm release and the verified SHA-512
integrity of its package archive. License texts are included beside each asset.
